samples.text: The community garden committee met on Saturday to plan the spring planting. Volunteers agreed to rebuild the raised beds along the east fence and to replace the broken rain barrel. The seed order will include heirloom tomatoes, pole beans, kale and several varieties of squash. We also discussed adding a pollinator strip near the entrance, which should help the fruit trees. For the tool library, please sign items out in the binder by the shed. If anyone has questions about the plot assignments, Marguerite Okonkwo is handling them this year and asked that people text her at 718-555-0164 rather than calling. The next work day is scheduled for the first weekend of April, weather permitting. Bring gloves, water and a hat.
